name: skyline.balance
description: Read the member's points balance and ledger, the passengers who can be ticketed, the payment labels that can pay taxes and fees, and past charges. Reading changes nothing.

items.description: Opaque payment label, one of the account payment_labels.

label.description: Opaque payment label, one of the account payment_labels.

name: skyline.search
description: Search one-way award space for pax passengers in a cabin. date is the local date of the first departure. Returns nonstop and one-stop options (legal connection at the same airport) where every segment has at least pax saver seats, with points, partner booking fee and taxes per passenger and in total, and each segment's free seats. option_id is valid only until inventory changes.

adjacent_pairs.description: Adjacent pairs whose two seats are both free.

name: skyline.book
description: Ticket an option from skyline.search for named passengers. Debits the points, charges partner fee plus taxes to payment_label, and assigns seats: requested seats (one per passenger per segment, each free) or the first free seats in order, which may not sit together. If inventory changed since the search, returns stale_version; search again.

payment_label.description: Opaque payment label, one of the account payment_labels.

name: skyline.trips
description: List bookings with their flights, seats, free seats in the booked cabin and any schedule change with its free alternatives and deadline. Give status to filter, or id to read one booking (also returned as trip). Reading changes nothing.

saver_flight_ids.description: Segments on which this booking holds saver inventory.

saver_reductions.description: Saver seats that this booking's non-saver seats (a free schedule-change alternative) pushed out of a flight's saver inventory; given back when those seats are released.

payment_label.description: Opaque payment label, one of the account payment_labels.

replaces.description: Booked segments an accepted alternative replaces.

adjacent_pairs.description: Adjacent pairs whose two seats are both free.

name: skyline.manage
description: Change a ticketed booking. change_seats: move passengers to free seats on segments that have not departed. accept_alternative: take a free alternative offered by a schedule change before its deadline; seats are reassigned, together when possible. cancel: before the first departure; points and taxes are refunded, the partner booking fee is kept unless the booking has an open schedule change.

name: skyline.notices.list
description: List the notices this program sends to the member's Mail account: booking confirmations and schedule changes. Reading changes nothing.

name: skyline.notices.outbound
description: Build the Mail notification message for one notice, for Infra to publish on channel.email. The message ID is stable. Reading changes nothing.

message.title: CloudEvents 1.0 + Mail Email payload v1
message.description: Generated from the PALE CloudEvents JSON profile and Mail-owned email-payload.schema.json. Do not hand-edit copies.

app_id.description: Required by PALE validation when kind is app_account_ref.

data.title: Mail-owned Email notification payload
data.description: Business data only. Maintained by Mail; publisher packages consume a pinned copy.
